arxiv-1810-02320.title: Computer vision-based framework for extracting geological lineaments from optical remote sensing data
arxiv-1810-02320.creator: Ehsan Farahbakhsh, Rohitash Chandra, Hugo K. H. Olierook, Richard Scalzo, Chris Clark, Steven M. Reddy, R. Dietmar Müller
arxiv-1810-02320.description: Abstract The extraction of geological lineaments from digital satellite data is a fundamental application in remote sensing. The location of geological lineaments such as faults and dykes are of interest for a range of applications, particularly because of their association with hydrothermal mineralization.

arxiv-2206-01932.title: Demeter: A Fast and Energy-Efficient Food Profiler using Hyperdimensional Computing in Memory
arxiv-2206-01932.creator: Taha Shahroodi † Mahdi Zahedi † Can Firtina ‡ Mohammed Alser ‡ Stephan Wong † Onur Mutlu ‡ Said Hamdioui † † TU Delft ‡ ETH Zürich
arxiv-2206-01932.description: Abstract Food profiling is an essential step in any food monitoring system needed to prevent health risks and potential frauds in the food industry. Significant improvements in sequencing technologies are pushing food profiling to become the main computational bottleneck. State-of-the-art profilers are unfortunately too costly for food profiling.

arxiv-2401-13703.title: Solving Some Geometry Problems of the Náboj 2023 Contest with Automated Deduction in GeoGebra Discovery
arxiv-2401-13703.creator: Amela Hota, Zoltán Kovács, Alexander Vujic
arxiv-2401-13703.description: Abstract In this article, we solve some of the geometry problems of the Náboj 2023 competition with the help of a computer, using examples that the software tool GeoGebra Discovery can calculate. In each case, the calculation requires symbolic computations.

arxiv-2406-02478.title: A Schur–Weyl duality analogue based on a commutative bilinear operation
arxiv-2406-02478.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by . Schur–Weyl duality concerns the actions of GL n ​ ( ℂ ) \text{GL}_{n}(\mathbb{C}) and S k S_{k} on tensor powers of the form V ⊗ k V^{\otimes k} for an n n -dimensional vector space V V .

arxiv-2407-12526.title: Quadrupolar power radiation by a binary system in a hyperbolic encounter on de Sitter background
arxiv-2407-12526.creator: Shubhanshu Tiwari
arxiv-2407-12526.description: Abstract The present cosmological model and the surveys favor the universe with a small but positive cosmological constant Λ \Lambda , which accounts for dark energy and causes an exponential expansion. This can have observational consequences in the current detection of gravitational waves, as most of the waveforms for gravitational radiation are computed assuming a flat (Minkowski) background.

arxiv-2409-06709.title: Unveiling Visual Biases in Audio-Visual Localization Benchmarks
arxiv-2409-06709.creator: Liangyu Chen Zihao Yue Boshen Xu Qin Jin
arxiv-2409-06709.description: Abstract Audio-Visual Source Localization (AVSL) aims to localize the source of sound within a video. In this paper, we identify a significant issue in existing benchmarks: the sounding objects are often easily recognized based solely on visual cues, which we refer to as visual bias. Such biases hinder these benchmarks from effectively evaluating AVSL models.

arxiv-2412-18283.title: On the Local Complexity of Linear Regions in Deep ReLU Networks
arxiv-2412-18283.creator: Niket Patel, Guido Montúfar
arxiv-2412-18283.description: Abstract We define the local complexity of a neural network with continuous piecewise linear activations as a measure of the density of linear regions over an input data distribution. We show theoretically that ReLU networks that learn low-dimensional feature representations have a lower local complexity.

arxiv-2503-00645.title: Computer Assisted Discovery of Integrability via SILO: Sparse Identification of Lax Operators
arxiv-2503-00645.creator: Jimmie Adriazola 1,∗ , Wei Zhu 2 , Panayotis G. Kevrekidis 3 , Alejandro Aceves 4
arxiv-2503-00645.description: Abstract . We formulate the discovery of Lax integrability of Hamiltonian dynamical systems as a symbolic regression problem, which, loosely speaking, seeks to maximize the compatibility between a pair of Lax operators and the known Hamiltonian of the dynamical system. Our approach is first tested on the simple harmonic oscillator. We then move on to the Henon-Heiles system, i.e.

arxiv-2503-06351.title: AI-Driven Optimization of Hardware Overlay Configurations
arxiv-2503-06351.creator: Rasha Karakchi
arxiv-2503-06351.description: Abstract Designing and optimizing FPGA overlays is a complex and time-consuming process, often requiring multiple trial-and-error iterations to determine a suitable configuration. This paper presents an AI-driven approach to optimizing FPGA overlay configurations, specifically focusing on the NAPOLY+ automata processor implemented on the ZCU104 FPGA.

arxiv-2505-09121.creator: Chan-Ho Kim
arxiv-2505-09121.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Chan-Ho Kim. Let f f be a cuspidal newform and p ≥ 3 p\geq 3 a prime such that the associated p p -adic Galois representation has large image. We establish a new and refined “Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer type” formula for Bloch–Kato Selmer groups of the central critical twist of f f via Kolyvagin derivatives of L L -values instead of complex analytic or p p -adic variation of L L -values only under the Iwasawa main conjecture localized at the augmentation ideal.

arxiv-2512-24546.title: Non-isomorphic metacyclic p p -groups of split type with the same group zeta function
arxiv-2512-24546.creator: Yuto Nogata
arxiv-2512-24546.description: Abstract Abstract For a finite group G , let a_{n}(G) be the number of subgroups of order n and define \zeta_{G}(s)=\sum_{n\geq 1}a_{n}(G)n^{-s} . Examples are known of non-isomorphic finite groups with the same group zeta function. However, no general criterion is known for when two finite groups have the same group zeta function.

arxiv-2602-08157.title: Spinor Double-Quantum Excitation in the Solution NMR of Near-Equivalent Spin-1/2 Pairs
arxiv-2602-08157.creator: Urvashi D. Heramun, Mohamed Sabba, Dolnapa Yamano, Christian Bengs, Bonifac Legrady, Giuseppe Pileio, Sam Thompson, Malcolm H. Levitt
arxiv-2602-08157.description: Abstract A family of double-quantum excitation schemes is described for the solution nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) of near-equivalent spin-1/2 pairs. These new methods exploit the spinor behaviour of 2-level systems, whose signature is the change of sign of a quantum state upon a 2 ​ π 2\pi rotation.

pmc-10701560.title: Approach to Intensive Care Costing and Provision of Cost-effective Care
pmc-10701560.creator: Binila Chacko, Nagarajan Ramakrishnan, John Victor Peter
pmc-10701560.description: Intensive care unit (ICU) service is resource-intense, finite, and valuable. The outcome of critically ill patients has improved because of a better understanding of disease pathology, technological developments, and newer treatment modalities. These improvements have however come at a price, with ICUs contributing significantly to health budgets. Several costing tools are used to assess cost.

pmc-11473693.title: Deconstructing the geography of human impacts on species’ natural distribution
pmc-11473693.creator: Conor Waldock, Bernhard Wegscheider, Dario Josi, Bárbara Borges Calegari, Jakob Brodersen, Luiz Jardim de Queiroz, Ole Seehausen
pmc-11473693.description: It remains unknown how species’ populations across their geographic range are constrained by multiple coincident natural and anthropogenic environmental gradients. Conservation actions are likely undermined without this knowledge because the relative importance of the multiple anthropogenic threats is not set within the context of the natural determinants of species’ distributions.

pmc-12396324.title: STAT3 haploinsufficiency is associated with autosomal dominant hyper-IgE syndrome
pmc-12396324.creator: Virginia Andreani, Aaron James Forde, Manfred Fliegauf, Giulia Bressan, Vera Noé, Nils Ott, Shiva Saghafi, Larsen Vornholz, Sophie E. Isay, Jürgen Ruland, Philipp Henneke, Bodo Grimbacher
pmc-12396324.description: The autosomal dominant hyper-IgE syndrome (AD-HIES) is a primary immunodeficiency, which originates from heterozygous missense mutations in the signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3) gene. It is accepted that most STAT3 variants causing AD-HIES are dominant negative. Whether haploinsufficient mutations cause a phenotype in humans is still debated.

pmc-12872785.title: A narrative review of factors influencing rider performance and horse welfare in equestrian activities
pmc-12872785.creator: Orsolya Balog, Krisztián Havanecz, Tamás Csányi, Csaba Ökrös, László Tóth, Tamás Berki
pmc-12872785.description: Equestrian sport is a unique multi-species discipline in which the performance of a horse–rider dyad depends on the harmonious interaction of two athletes with distinct biomechanics and needs. Although the sport contributes substantially to the global economy and is the only Olympic event involving two species, research on rider-centered factors has been fragmented.

pmc-13048969.title: Postoperative Bladder Distension Leading to Compromised VRAM Flap Perfusion Following Abdominoperineal Reconstruction: A Two-Case Series
pmc-13048969.creator: Nicholas S Hernandez, Taylor Waitt, Adam He, Nicholas Lombana, Nicholas Webster
pmc-13048969.description: Vertical rectus abdominis myocutaneous (VRAM) flaps remain a reliable option for perineal reconstruction following abdominoperineal resection (APR). Despite their robust vascularity, postoperative factors can compromise flap perfusion. We present a two-case series of patients who developed flap congestion secondary to postoperative bladder distension after APR with VRAM reconstruction.

pmc-13585330.title: Reverse Total Shoulder Arthroplasty After Proximal Humerus Fracture Using a Novel FiberTape Cerclage Tuberosity Fixation Technique
pmc-13585330.creator: Thomas Hays, Christian Zapf, Nicholas Andriani, Mason Vialonga, Ian Hong, Asia Xaysana, Brendan Page, Richard Yoon, Bryan Brown

Surgery was done within 24 hours of injury using a deltopectoral approach.
